Thanks for the logs and the X-Request-Id (vc-req-20261109-843). A few initial hypotheses and a request list so we can repro on our side: 

Hypotheses:
- The 502s look like upstream worker stalls (OOM or GC pause) surfaced by our gateway as a Bad Gateway when a worker fails to respond in time.
- We route by model footprint + region; under high burst a shard can overflow and requests forwarded to a fallback pool which, if saturated, can return 502s.
- Large payloads / long sequences during batch encoding can increase per-request cpu/worker time, exacerbating the issue.

What we need to repro: exact curl/SKD call (headers included), SDK options (timeout, retries), and a sanitized request body sample (sequence lengths). The X-Request-Id you provided is helpful.

Immediate mitigations to try (non-disruptive):
- Reduce indexing concurrency from 120 -> 64 and monitor success rate.
- Set per-request timeout to 15s and enable SDK-level exponential backoff with jitter.
- If using hosted endpoints, pin region to us-west-2 to avoid cross-region tail latency.

I'll attach redwood_config_patch.yaml and a JS snippet for retries in a follow-up. We will also search vc-req-20261109-843 in our gateway traces and paste the trace here before the call.

Rishi
